title: द्वादशोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Nakula, looking at the king, tells him that the true renunciant is the one who gives up desire, not the one who leaves his home. He urges Yudhishthira to rule and to keep the dharma of a king, performing sacrifices.
summary.kn: ರಾಜನನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ನಕುಲ ಮನೆ ಬಿಡುವವನಲ್ಲ, ಆಸೆ ತೊರೆದವನೇ ನಿಜ ಸಂನ್ಯಾಸಿಯೆಂದು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನಿಗೆ ಆಳಲು, ರಾಜಧರ್ಮ ಪಾಲಿಸಲು, ಯಜ್ಞ ಮಾಡಲು ಒತ್ತಾಯಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: नकुल राजा से कहते हैं कि सच्चा त्यागी वह है जो इच्छा छोड़ता है, घर छोड़ने वाला नहीं। वे युधिष्ठिर से राज करने, राजधर्म निभाने और यज्ञ करने का आग्रह करते हैं।
summary.te: నకులుడు రాజుతో ఇంటిని వదిలినవాడు కాక కోరికను వదిలినవాడే నిజమైన సన్యాసి అంటాడు. పాలించమని, రాజధర్మాన్ని పాటించమని, యజ్ఞాలు చేయమని యుధిష్ఠిరుని కోరతాడు.
summary.ta: வீட்டை விடுபவன் அல்ல, ஆசையை விடுபவனே உண்மைத் துறவி என்று நகுலன் மன்னரிடம் கூறுகிறான். ஆளவும் ராஜதர்மத்தைக் காக்கவும் வேள்விகள் செய்யவும் யுதிஷ்டிரரை வற்புறுத்துகிறான்.
summary.ml: രാജാവിനെ നോക്കി നകുലൻ പറയുന്നു: യഥാർത്ഥ സന്ന്യാസി വീടുവിടുന്നവനല്ല, ആഗ്രഹം ഉപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നവനാണ്. ഭരിക്കാനും യജ്ഞങ്ങൾ ചെയ്ത് രാജധർമ്മം പാലിക്കാനും അദ്ദേഹം യുധിഷ്ഠിരനോട് അഭ്യർത്ഥിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.12; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
अर्जुनस्य वचः श्रुत्वा नकुलो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।
राजानमभिसंप्रेक्ष्य सर्वधर्मभृतां वरम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing Arjuna's words, Nakula spoke, looking at the king, best of those who uphold all dharma.

verses.text:
अनुरुध्य महाप्राज्ञो भ्रातुश्चित्तमरिंदमः ।
व्यूढोरस्को महाबाहुस्ताम्रास्यो मितभाषिता ॥

meaning.en: The wise tormentor of foes, broad-chested, mighty-armed, copper-faced and measured in speech, spoke in accord with his brother's mind.

verses.text:
विशाखयूपे देवानां सर्वेषामग्नयश्चिताः ।
तस्माद्विद्धि महाराज देवान्कर्मपथि स्थितान् ॥

meaning.en: Nakula said: At the Vishakhayupa the fires of all the gods have been piled up. From this, great king, know that the gods stand on the path of action.

verses.text:
अनास्तिकानास्तिकानां प्राणदाः पितरश्च ये ।
तेऽपि कर्मैव कुर्वन्ति विधिं पश्यस्व पार्थिव ।
वेदवादापविद्धांस्तु तान्विद्धि भृशनास्तिकान् ॥

meaning.en: Even the ancestors, who are not unbelievers and who give life to unbelievers, do nothing but act. See the rule, O king. But know those cast out from the Vedic teaching to be utter unbelievers.

verses.text:
न हि वेदोक्तमुत्सृज्य विप्रः सर्वेषु कर्मसु ।
देवयानेन नाकस्य पृष्ठमाप्नोति भारत ॥

meaning.en: A brahmin who gives up what the Veda prescribes in all rites does not reach the heights of heaven by the way of the gods, Bharata.

verses.text:
अत्याश्रमानयं सर्वानित्याहुर्वेदनिश्चयाः ।
ब्राह्मणाः श्रुतिसंपन्नास्तान्निबोध जनाधिप ॥

meaning.en: Those with firm judgment in the Veda say that this way surpasses all the stages of life. Learn of them, lord of men, the learned brahmins.

verses.text:
वित्तानि धर्मलब्धानि क्रतुमुख्येष्ववासृजन् ।
कृतात्मसु महाराज स वै त्यागी स्मृतो नरः ॥

meaning.en: The man who offers wealth lawfully earned into the best of sacrifices, among those of trained self, great king, is remembered as the true renouncer.

verses.text:
अनवेक्ष्य सुखादानं तथैवोर्ध्वं प्रतिष्ठितः ।
आत्मत्यागी महाराज स त्यागी तामसः प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: One who gives no thought to enjoyment and likewise stays fixed on the higher goal, great king, is a renouncer of himself; he is, my lord, a renouncer of the dark kind.

verses.text:
अनिकेतः परिपतन्वृक्षमूलाश्रयो मुनिः ।
अपाचकः सदा योगी स त्यागी पार्थ भिक्षुकः ॥

meaning.en: A homeless wanderer, a sage taking shelter at the foot of trees, who cooks nothing and is always a yogi, Partha, is a renouncer and a mendicant.

verses.text:
क्रोधहर्षावनादृत्य पैशुन्यं च विशां पते ।
विप्रो वेदानधीते यः स त्यागी गुरुपूजकः ॥

meaning.en: A brahmin who studies the Vedas, disregarding anger, joy and slander, O lord of the people, is a renouncer and one who honors his teacher.

verses.text:
आश्रमांस्तुलया सर्वान्धृतानाहुर्मनीषिणः ।
एकतस्ते त्रयो राजन्गृहस्थाश्रम एकतः ॥

meaning.en: The wise say that when all the stages of life are weighed in a balance, three are on one side and the householder's stage on the other, O king.

verses.text:
समीक्षते तु योऽर्थं वै कामं स्वर्गं च भारत ।
अयं पन्था महर्षीणामियं लोकविदां गतिः ॥

meaning.en: He who looks to wealth, desire and heaven, Bharata, says: "This is the path of the great sages, this is the way of those who know the world."

verses.text:
इति यः कुरुते भावं स त्यागी भरतर्षभ ।
न यः परित्यज्य गृहान्वनमेति विमूढवत् ॥

meaning.en: Whoever holds this attitude is a renouncer, best of the Bharatas, not he who abandons his home and goes to the forest like a fool.

verses.text:
यदा कामान्समीक्षेत धर्मवैतंसिकोऽनृजुः ।
अथैनं मृत्युपाशेन कण्ठे बध्नाति मृत्युराट् ॥

meaning.en: When a crooked man who uses dharma as a snare turns his eyes to desires, the king of death binds him by the neck with the noose of death.

verses.text:
अभिमानकृतं कर्म नैतत्फलवदुच्यते ।
त्यागयुक्तं महाराज सर्वमेव महाफलम् ॥

meaning.en: A deed done out of pride is not called fruitful. But everything joined with renunciation, great king, bears great fruit.

verses.text:
शमो दमस्तपो दानं सत्यं शौचमथार्जवम् ।
यज्ञो धृतिश्च धर्मश्च नित्यमार्षो विधिः स्मृतः ॥

meaning.en: Calm, self-control, austerity, giving, truth, purity, honesty, sacrifice, steadiness and dharma are remembered as the perpetual rule of the sages.

verses.text:
पितृदेवातिथिकृते समारम्भोऽत्र शस्यते ।
अत्रैव हि महाराज त्रिवर्गः केवलं फलम् ॥

meaning.en: Undertaking works for ancestors, gods and guests is praised here, and here alone, great king, is the threefold aim the sole fruit.

verses.text:
एतस्मिन्वर्तमानस्य विधौ विप्रनिषेविते ।
त्यागिनः प्रसृतस्येह नोच्छित्तिर्विद्यते क्वचित् ॥

meaning.en: For a renouncer who walks by this rule, practiced by brahmins, there is nowhere any ruin.

verses.text:
असृजद्धि प्रजा राजन्प्रजापतिरकल्मषः ।
मां यक्ष्यन्तीति शान्तात्मा यज्ञैर्विविधदक्षिणैः ॥

meaning.en: The sinless Lord of Creatures made beings, with a peaceful mind, thinking, "They will worship me with sacrifices with many kinds of gifts."

verses.text:
वीरुधश्चैव वृक्षांश्च यज्ञार्थं च तथौषधीः ।
पशूंश्चैव तथा मेध्यान्यज्ञार्थानि हवींषि च ॥

meaning.en: He made creepers and trees, and herbs for the sake of sacrifice, and sacrificial animals, and pure offerings for sacrifice.

verses.text:
गृहस्थाश्रमिणस्तच्च यज्ञकर्म विरोधकम् ।
तस्माद्गार्हस्थ्यमेवेह दुष्करं दुर्लभं तथा ॥

meaning.en: That work of sacrifice belongs to the householder's order and is demanding; therefore the householder's life is hard and rare in this world.

verses.text:
तत्संप्राप्य गृहस्था ये पशुधान्यसमन्विताः ।
न यजन्ते महाराज शाश्वतं तेषु किल्बिषम् ॥

meaning.en: Householders who have this life, with animals and grain, and do not sacrifice, great king, carry a lasting guilt.

verses.text:
स्वाध्याययज्ञा ऋषयो ज्ञानयज्ञास्तथापरे ।
अथापरे महायज्ञान्मनसैव वितन्वते ॥

meaning.en: Some sages sacrifice by study, others by knowledge, and still others perform the great sacrifices in the mind alone.

verses.text:
एवं दानसमाधानं मार्गमातिष्ठतो नृप ।
द्विजातेर्ब्रह्मभूतस्य स्पृहयन्ति दिवौकसः ॥

meaning.en: The dwellers in heaven envy the twice-born who has become one with Brahman and who follows this path of giving and concentration, O king.

verses.text:
स रत्नानि विचित्राणि संभृतानि ततस्ततः ।
मखेष्वनभिसंत्यज्य नास्तिक्यमभिजल्पसि ।
कुटुम्बमास्थिते त्यागं न पश्यामि नराधिप ॥

meaning.en: You have gathered marvelous jewels from all sides, and yet, without giving them up in sacrifices, you talk of unbelief. I see no renunciation in one who clings to his household, lord of men.

verses.text:
राजसूयाश्वमेधेषु सर्वमेधेषु वा पुनः ।
य चान्ये क्रतवस्तात ब्राह्मणैरभिपूजिताः ।
तैर्यजस्व महाराज शक्रो देवपतिर्यथा ॥

meaning.en: Perform the Rajasuya, the Ashvamedha, and the Sarvamedha, and the other sacrifices that brahmins honor, great king, just as Shakra, lord of the gods, did.

verses.text:
राज्ञः प्रमाददोषेण दस्युभिः परिमुष्यताम् ।
अशरण्यः प्रजानां यः स राजा कलिरुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: A king who is not a refuge for his people, when through his negligence they are plundered by bandits, is called Kali.

verses.text:
अश्वान्गाश्चैव दासीश्च करेणूश्च स्वलंकृताः ।
ग्रामाञ्जनपदांश्चैव क्षेत्राणि च गृहाणि च ॥

meaning.en: If we do not give horses, cows, maidservants, richly adorned she-elephants, villages, districts, fields and houses to the twice-born,

verses.text:
अप्रदाय द्विजातिभ्यो मात्सर्याविष्टचेतसः ।
वयं ते राजकलयो भविष्यामो विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: then, lord of the people, with minds seized by grudging, we shall become mere fragments of Kali among kings.

verses.text:
अदातारोऽशरण्याश्च राजकिल्बिषभागिनः ।
दुःखानामेव भोक्तारो न सुखानां कदाचन ॥

meaning.en: Non-givers, without refuge, sharing a king's guilt, they enjoy only sorrows and never pleasures.

verses.text:
अनिष्ट्वा च महायज्ञैरकृत्वा च पितृस्वधाम् ।
तीर्थेष्वनभिसंत्यज्य प्रव्रजिष्यसि चेदथ ॥

meaning.en: If, without sacrificing with the great sacrifices, without making the ancestors' offerings, and without giving at the holy places, you go forth as a wanderer,

verses.text:
छिन्नाभ्रमिव गन्तासि विलयं मारुतेरितम् ।
लोकयोरुभयोर्भ्रष्टो ह्यन्तराले व्यवस्थितः ॥

meaning.en: you will go like a torn cloud scattered by the wind, fallen from both worlds and left hanging in between.

verses.text:
अन्तर्बहिश्च यत्किंचिन्मनोव्यासङ्गकारकम् ।
परित्यज्य भवेत्त्यागी न यो हित्वा प्रतिष्ठते ॥

meaning.en: Whatever within or without binds the mind, leave it behind and be a renouncer. He who leaves and then does not stay firm is not one.

verses.text:
एतस्मिन्वर्तमानस्य विधौ विप्रनिषेविते ।
ब्राह्मणस्य महाराज नोच्छित्तिर्विद्यते क्वचित् ॥

meaning.en: For a brahmin who lives by this rule, which brahmins follow, great king, there is nowhere any ruin.

verses.text:
निहत्य शत्रूंस्तरसा समृद्धा-
न्शक्रो यथा दैत्यबलानि संख्ये ।
कः पार्थ शोचेन्निरतः स्वधर्मे
पूर्वैः स्मृते पार्थिव शिष्टजुष्टे ॥

meaning.en: Partha, who would grieve, being devoted to his own dharma as the ancients remembered it and good people practiced, having swiftly killed prosperous enemies as Shakra killed the hosts of the Daityas in battle?

verses.text:
क्षात्रेण धर्मेण पराक्रमेण
जित्वा महीं मन्त्रविद्भ्यः प्रदाय ।
नाकस्य पृष्ठेऽसि नरेन्द्र गन्ता
न शोचितव्यं भवताद्य पार्थ ॥

meaning.en: Having won the earth by the warrior's dharma and prowess, and having given it to those who know the sacred formulas, you will go to the heights of heaven, O king. You should not grieve now, Partha.
